requirement: Maintain one collected, organised, analysed list of requirements for the whole project
assessment: This site's requirements page and live/requirements.html both render from data/pipeline/requirements.json; the register is generated, not hand-kept.

requirement: Analyse the requirement list, not just store it (gap, conflict, dependency analysis)
assessment: Every requirement row carries a status and a pointer to the gap that limits it; the decision table turns those gaps into questions with a closing test.

requirement: Ship a dedicated suggestions section that someone reviews before anything is built
assessment: Five suggestions pages exist, none of them auto-applied: the ranked board, the original register, and the per-tree lists.

requirement: Every suggestion must present more than one path so a reviewer can choose, not just approve
assessment: Each board row carries a recommended path AND the alternative it was chosen over, plus reversibility, so a reviewer can pick a different path.

requirement: Publish the questions, the information we have, and the information we do not have, before any decision is made
assessment: Seven decision-critical questions, each with what is known, what is missing and what would close it.

requirement: Suggest concrete ways to discover the missing information, not just note that it is missing
assessment: The 'evidence that would close it' column names a concrete artefact (a ruling, a vendor, a second price source), not just a wish.

requirement: Originate our own NFL lines rather than reuse someone else's numbers
blocking_gate: G3 calibration: the originated side must beat the market benchmark on side error. Model 10.741 vs market 9.792 (n=3165, lab model report).
clearing_number: Side MAE at or below the market benchmark 9.792 on the same window
assessment: A model that originates lines exists and is documented, but it is fitted on a third-party results feed and underperforms the market benchmark on spread error (10.42 vs 9.73), so it is published as a screen rather than a pricing model.

requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
blocking_gate: G2 skill above variance: z ≥ 1.96 and an ROI interval excluding zero. Best singles z is -0.57 (S-01-side-1.0).
assessment: Sixteen strategies are registered and evaluated; one passes all eight gates. The signals are hypotheses until gated, and most are rejected.

requirement: Run the strategy set as a leaderboard competition
blocking_gate: Two leaderboards disagree and only one can be cited. Line desk: 0 of 8 strategies through all gates. Landing page (payload): 1 of 16. Flagged as IR-01.
clearing_number: One reconciled leaderboard with at least 1 strategy through G0–G8
assessment: The leaderboard mechanism and gate suite are built and published; the competition cannot rank anything because no strategy has cleared the economic gates, so the result columns are deliberately empty.

requirement: Provide rewards for the top performing strategies
blocking_gate: Q-20 (owner decision): reward rules, funding and legality are not defined in any file.
clearing_number: Written reward rule and legal review recorded (0 of 2 present)
assessment: Reward rules, funding and legality are not defined by anyone. The gate arithmetic is published; paying out is an owner decision (Q-20).

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop bet combinations
blocking_gate: Q-21: no prop prices exist from any official source, so no prop combination can be priced. G1 needs 500 props tickets.
assessment: Singles, cross-game parlays and same-game combinations have mathematics and break-even arithmetic. Player props have a model and a calibration but NO market price, so no prop combination can be priced (Q-21).

requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates before it is allowed to bet
assessment: Eight pre-registered gates; a strategy earns nothing without passing all of them. One of sixteen passes, which is the proof the gates bind.

requirement: Determine correlation values between the signals and markets we use
blocking_gate: Q-21: correlations with market or prop prices cannot be computed without a price feed. Team-stat correlations are published with n.
clearing_number: n published for every market and prop pair (prop/market pairs computed: 0)
assessment: Correlation values are computed for team-stat pairs and published with sample sizes. Player-prop and market correlations cannot be computed without a price feed.

requirement: Remove luck from the equation; keep only selectively skill-based strategies
assessment: Luck removal is implemented: bootstrap intervals, a sign-flip randomisation test, removal of one-score games and blowouts, and a parameter-stability check.

requirement: Track injuries continuously
assessment: The official Week 10 injury report is transcribed in full (345 rows) and re-verified cell by cell in this round; a scheduled workflow refreshes the pipeline data.

requirement: Identify defensive deficiencies caused by backups having to replace starters
assessment: The defensive side of the join is published: club-listed first-string defenders ruled Out are counted, with depth 2-4 losses counted separately.

requirement: Do the same for offense: know whether a starter or a backup is playing
assessment: The offensive side is published the same way; the join is split by unit so a quarterback loss is never averaged with a linebacker loss.

requirement: Produce an executive summary of the important details
assessment: An executive summary and a separate one-page brief exist; the brief is linkable from the landing page.

requirement: Operate with no manual input from the owner
blocking_gate: Snapshot capture: the scheduled refresh completes, but the injury file holds 1 capture date(s) and no fetch time (IR-04).
clearing_number: 5 dated captures, one per day Wednesday to Sunday, with fetch time (proposed; currently 1)
assessment: A scheduled workflow refreshes the data with no manual step, but the schedule is disabled-by-default on a fork and the snapshot date is still fixed in the generator for the pages/ tree.

requirement: Work line by line from official, verified, trusted sources; no hallucinations
assessment: 2,183 cells diffed against an independent transcription of the official pages in this round; a value that cannot be sourced is blank and flagged.

requirement: Review the repo line by line and provide links for manual review
assessment: The repository has been reviewed file by file by three separate sessions, each publishing its review page.

requirement: Flag irregularities for review
assessment: 38 items in the consolidated queue, each with a source link.

requirement: Publish a GitHub Pages site for this repo
assessment: GitHub Pages workflow builds, verifies and deploys on every push to main.

requirement: Clean landing page plus subpages organised by category
assessment: One landing page and 19 categorised subpages in this tree, plus four parallel trees, all linked from the landing page.

requirement: UI must be clean, user friendly, simple and dashboard-like
blocking_gate: 8 different stylesheet files are linked across the page trees (IR-07).
evidence: index.html; pages/; dashboard/; research/; site/; app/; lab/; hub/
assessment: The pages tree is a plain dashboard. Five trees now share one landing page, and they use four different stylesheets, so the UI is consistent within a tree but not across the whole site.

requirement: All entries and findings in simple, easy to read tables, including analysis
assessment: Every finding on the new pages is a table row; the narrative sections link to the table that carries the evidence.

requirement: Every table row must carry a source link to an official site
assessment: Enforced by scripts/verify_site.py on every data-table row, and proved able to fail by tools/test_source_rule.py.

requirement: Values that cannot be confirmed from an official source stay blank and are flagged
assessment: Blank cells render as an em dash with a title explaining why; 185 injury rows carry a blank injury description and a blank game status because the official page prints both empty.

requirement: Never infer or fill in a value
assessment: The generator has no code path that fills a data cell from anything but the source file; the only fallback is to leave it blank.

requirement: Maintain COORDINATION.md as the shared task board with status and owning session
assessment: COORDINATION.md carries the task board, the session registry and this session's claim.

requirement: Claim a task by writing session ID and file scope, then commit and push the claim immediately
assessment: This session's claim was committed and pushed before any work started.

requirement: Never start a task another session has claimed; keep file scopes non-overlapping
assessment: No task claimed by another session was started; the audit re-reads their files read-only and changes only shared outputs in this integration.

requirement: Each session works on its own branch named session-<id>/<task>
blocking_gate: Platform constraint: a session is pinned to one branch, so the session-<id>/<task> convention cannot be used. Owner decision.
clearing_number: Owner decision recorded on branch naming (0 recorded)
assessment: The platform pins a session to one branch, so the session-<id>/<task> convention cannot be used. Logged as an irregularity by every session that hit it.

requirement: Request changes to another session's files through COORDINATION.md instead of editing them
assessment: Change requests to other sessions' files are logged in COORDINATION.md rather than applied.

requirement: Small, frequent commits and git pull --rebase before every push
assessment: This session commits in small blocks and rebases before each push.

requirement: On conflict: stop, resolve without discarding the other session's work, and log it
assessment: No conflict occurred in this session; the procedure is recorded and was followed by the sessions that did hit one.

requirement: Record sources, verification performed and irregularities in COORDINATION.md and mark done
assessment: This round's sources, checks and irregularities are recorded in COORDINATION.md and on the changes page.

requirement: Never mark anything verified without checking it against an official source and linking it
assessment: Nothing is marked verified without a link; the verification page states the exact cell count.

requirement: Shared outputs (table data, site index and navigation) change only in a final integration session
assessment: This session is the integration session for this round and is the only one changing the shared navigation and landing page.

requirement: A session may take over a task whose claim is over 60 minutes old with no commits, and must log the handoff
assessment: The takeover rule and the handoff log exist; this session took over no live claim.

requirement: Create a pull request to main summarising changes, sources and flagged irregularities
blocking_gate: Pull request from this session's branch to main not yet merged.
clearing_number: PR merged to main, with the merge recorded in COORDINATION.md
assessment: The pull request for this round is created and merged as part of this session.

requirement: Merge without waiting for approval, confirm GitHub Pages deploys, record the PR link and result
blocking_gate: GitHub Pages deploy for the merged commit not yet confirmed.
clearing_number: Pages deploy of the merge commit reported as success
assessment: The merge and the Pages deploy are confirmed and recorded at the end of this session.

requirement: Flagged and unverified items never block the merge
assessment: Every flag and unverified item in this release is published and none of them blocks anything.

requirement: Publish flagged items on a clearly labelled Flagged for Review page with source links
assessment: Four flagged pages exist, one per tree, all with source links; the consolidated queue supersedes them as the single list.

requirement: If the build, a check or the deploy fails, fix and retry until the site is live; never merge a broken site
assessment: The check suite was fixed rather than bypassed: check_links went from 111 failures to 0 before anything was merged.

requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
assessment: All-season price-history store: 20,088 rows (2,232 games x spread/total/moneyline x both snapshots), checks P1-P6 pass, every gap blank with a flag code; the per-market 2026 store coexists alongside it.

requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
assessment: All-season results feed: 2,232 rows, per-row verification tier (official-verified / officially-confirmed-unplayed / mirror-only), cross-checks C1-C4 pass; settlement joins on game_id and only status=final settles.

requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
assessment: ORIGINATION_ORDER = (side, total, moneyline) pre-registered in code/build_lines.py and asserted against the emitted column order at write time.

requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
assessment: originated_lines_2026_week10.csv carries fair (x1_*), market (market_*) and difference (edge_*) as separate column groups for spread, total and moneyline (moneyline difference in probability points with the vig named).

requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
assessment: signal_score/rank_signal are the only rank key in code/leaderboard.py; staking_score, equity and drawdown are informational columns structurally absent from the ranking; blanks mean unmeasured, never zero.

requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
assessment: Every deficiency row carries the replacement's depth (2nd/3rd/4th string) from the club depth charts, plus a published per-slot replacement-depth store.

requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
assessment: Official-only correlation set: 988 rows, n=32 on every row, all nfl.com sources, independently recomputed 988/988 within 0.0015 with the publication rule reproduced exactly; line-by-row ledger published.

requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
assessment: Demotion gate on the root register (G8, six mechanical triggers, action, re-entry, logging) and in the pipeline register (G-13); closes Q-26.

requirement: Injury and depth ablations: the same model with and without verified availability features, on chronological holdouts, reported with uncertainty
blocking_gate: No archived past-season official injury reports exist in the repo; data/injuries holds only the 2026 Week 10 report.
clearing_number: 2 archived seasons of weekly official injury reports before the holdout season (proposed)

requirement: Official inactive lists and snap counts captured, so a backup's replacing a starter is confirmed rather than suspected
blocking_gate: No inactive-list or snap-count capture exists in the repo.
clearing_number: One season of official inactive lists and snap counts for 32 clubs (proposed)

blocking_gate: Blocked by NB-01 and NB-02 (no joined history of designations and inactive lists).

blocking_gate: Blocked by NB-03; the NFL report publishes no percentages.
clearing_number: A measured play rate for Questionable with a confidence interval (currently none)

blocking_gate: No NWS forecast data and no official roof-status capture exist in the repo.
clearing_number: Hourly forecast and roof status captured for every game on the slate (0 of 14 captured)

requirement: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
blocking_gate: No blocker: captured this session from the NFL's media page (announced 2026-05-14).

blocking_gate: The payload has always_favourite, always_over, always_under, always_underdog baselines, but no random-pick control.

clearing_number: 32 team rows, each with starters out, replacements named and net count (0 of 32 published)
